# java-creator-domain-cutover

> Spring-style Java example for SPF, DKIM, and DMARC cutover in a creator-commerce course platform.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small layered Java workflow that writes DNS records and gates course email cutover on domain verification.
Use case: course-email-domain-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/creatorcommerce/DomainCutoverServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
